Reporter Tom O'Neill lays out his book CHAOS for Rogan in episode 1459 of the Joe Rogan Experience. O'Neill spent twenty years digging into Charles Manson, the CIA, and the dark side of the sixties. What began as a magazine piece became an obsession.

He tells Rogan what he found in the files: Manson's odd ties, missed chances by police, and hints of mind-control research nearby. Rogan follows the trail and tests its weakest links. The episode is true crime in talk form, a long, gripping report on how one case kept hiding new rooms behind every door.
podcast-joerogan-dLfi4lSFwg8:
Vince and Emily Horn of Buddhist Geeks join the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 530. The Horns built a podcast and community around the meeting point of Buddhism and technology. Their subject is what happens to an ancient practice when it runs on modern wires.

They talk with Rogan about meditation apps, online teachers, and whether the wired mind can still sit still. Rogan asks how practice changes when a retreat fits in a pocket. The episode is a gentle, early look at digital dharma, from two pioneers who believed the dharma and the digital age had to learn to live together.
